reviews.text: 24-hour emergency service, we brought in a kitten with an injury and they have a boarding service.
Excellent service at all times, highly recommended.

Excellent service from the entire veterinary team at the clinic. Everything is handled with respect, clear rules, and kind treatment of the animals and their owners. They've always been there for me in emergency situations with my dogs, and they've managed to pull them through (the first time, they were the only ones who saw me at 4 a.m. when my dog ​​was almost unconscious). I highly recommend this clinic and suggest making an appointment to avoid large crowds and for better service. 💜
The doctors were excellent, especially Dr. Diego Rivera. They saved my 12-year-old Yorkie from pyometra. We are all so happy. Thank you!

I requested Dr. Gabriel Gutiérrez's services 12 or 15 years ago, and Toño kindly answered my call in the middle of the night because my cat was seriously ill. He had been hospitalized with pneumonia, and Dr. Gutiérrez pulled him through.
Today, my cat is 16 years old and doing very well. I highly recommend this place for our pets ❤️

Terrible.

Let me tell you:

1st time:

My dog ​​was hospitalized for dehydration and they wouldn't let her go to the bathroom. When I went to visit her, I saw she was covered in poop and they tried to sell me a bathroom without cleaning her, saying, "Well, there are wipes and water here if you want to clean her." After I took her to the bathroom during my visit, she peed a lot because of the IV fluids, and they never took her to the bathroom again.

I was worried during her stay and called, but they didn't answer, so I went in person. They told me that ONLY TWO STATUS UPDATES WERE ALLOWED and they couldn't give me any more information ℹ️...LACK OF EMPATHY

Second time: I took my dog ​​in because she had been attacked by another dog and had a torn muscle in her paw. They didn't treat it as an emergency and told me to wait because they were attending to a NORMAL consultation. They tied a rope around her muzzle the whole time I waited, in case she was aggressive, and my dog ​​was bleeding and receiving no attention.

The owner and a relative of mine arrived. We told him we weren't getting any attention, but he did nothing, so we decided to go to another vet. He told us, "FINE, IF THEY DO A BAD PROCEDURE THERE, IT'S NOT OUR FAULT IF HE DIES."... How unprofessional!

Go to better clinics; it's not worth "saving money" on your pet's well-being.

I hope this serves as a warning to others.
